audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for hour/glory prayer, age-long life as knowing Father/Son, keeping the name, protection, sanctification in truth, mission, oneness language, glory/love indwelling.

verses.restored: Jesus spoke these things, and lifting his eyes to heaven, said, Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son, so that the Son may glorify you.

familiar.text: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

modern.text: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.

original.text: Ταῦτα ⸀ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ⸂ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶπεν⸃· Πάτερ, ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα· δόξασόν σου τὸν υἱόν, ⸀ἵνα ὁ ⸀υἱὸς δοξάσῃ σέ,

verses.restored: Just as you gave him authority over all flesh/embodied humanity, so that all whom you have given him, he may give them age-long life.

familiar.text: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

modern.text: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.

original.text: καθὼς ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν πάσης σαρκός, ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκας αὐτῷ ⸀δώσῃ αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

verses.restored: This is age-long life: that they may know you, the only true Divine, and Jesus Messiah whom you sent.

familiar.text: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

modern.text: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.

original.text: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ αἰώνιος ζωὴ ἵνα γινώσκωσι σὲ τὸν μόνον ἀληθινὸν θεὸν καὶ ὃν ἀπέστειλας Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν.

verses.restored: I glorified you on the earth, completing the work that you have given me to do.

familiar.text: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

modern.text: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.

original.text: ἐγώ σε ἐδόξασα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὸ ἔργον ⸀τελειώσας ὃ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ποιήσω·

verses.restored: And now, Father, glorify me beside yourself with the glory I had beside you before the world was.

familiar.text: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

modern.text: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed. Prayer for the Disciples

original.text: καὶ νῦν δόξασόν με σύ, πάτερ, παρὰ σεαυτῷ τῇ δόξῃ ᾗ εἶχον πρὸ τοῦ τὸν κόσμον εἶναι παρὰ σοί.

verses.restored: I revealed your name to the humans whom you gave me from the world. They were yours, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.

familiar.text: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

modern.text: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.

original.text: Ἐφανέρωσά σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις οὓς ⸀ἔδωκάς μοι ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου. σοὶ ἦσαν κἀμοὶ αὐτοὺς ⸁ἔδωκας, καὶ τὸν λόγον σου τετήρηκαν.

verses.restored: Now they have known that all things you have given me are from you.

familiar.text: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

modern.text: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.

original.text: νῦν ἔγνωκαν ὅτι πάντα ὅσα ⸀δέδωκάς μοι παρὰ σοῦ ⸀εἰσιν·

verses.restored: For the words that you gave me I have given them, and they received them and knew truly that I came out from you, and they trusted that you sent me.

familiar.text: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

modern.text: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.

original.text: ὅτι τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ⸀ἔδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλαβον καὶ ἔγνωσαν ἀληθῶς ὅτι παρὰ σοῦ ἐξῆλθον, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.

verses.restored: I ask concerning them; I do not ask concerning the world, but concerning those whom you have given me, because they are yours.

familiar.text: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

modern.text: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.

original.text: ἐγὼ περὶ αὐτῶν ἐρωτῶ· οὐ περὶ τοῦ κόσμου ἐρωτῶ ἀλλὰ περὶ ὧν δέδωκάς μοι, ὅτι σοί εἰσιν,

verses.restored: All my things are yours, and yours mine, and I have been glorified in them.

familiar.text: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

modern.text: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.

original.text: καὶ τὰ ἐμὰ πάντα σά ἐστιν καὶ τὰ σὰ ἐμά, καὶ δεδόξασμαι ἐν αὐτοῖς.

verses.restored: I am no longer in the world, and they are in the world, and I come to you. Holy Father, keep them in your name that you have given me, so that they may be one just as we are.

familiar.text: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

modern.text: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.

original.text: καὶ οὐκέτι εἰμὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, καὶ ⸀αὐτοὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰσίν, κἀγὼ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι. πάτερ ἅγιε, τήρησον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν ⸀καθὼς ἡμεῖς.

verses.restored: When I was with them, I kept them in your name that you have given me. I guarded them, and none of them was lost except the son of loss, so that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

familiar.text: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

modern.text: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.

original.text: ὅτε ἤμην μετʼ ⸀αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἐτήρουν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ⸀ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, ⸀καὶ ἐφύλαξα, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπώλετο εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας, ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ.

verses.restored: But now I come to you, and these things I speak in the world, so that they may have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

familiar.text: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

modern.text: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.

original.text: νῦν δὲ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι, καὶ ταῦτα λαλῶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἵνα ἔχωσιν τὴν χαρὰν τὴν ἐμὴν πεπληρωμένην ἐν ⸀ἑαυτοῖς.

verses.restored: I have given them your word, and the world hated them because they are not from the world, just as I am not from the world.

familiar.text: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

modern.text: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

original.text: ἐγὼ δέδωκα αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον σου, καὶ ὁ κόσμος ἐμίσησεν αὐτούς, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.

verses.restored: I do not ask that you take them out of the world, but that you keep them from the harmful one.

familiar.text: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

modern.text: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.

original.text: οὐκ ἐρωτῶ ἵνα ἄρῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλʼ ἵνα τηρήσῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ.

verses.restored: They are not from the world, just as I am not from the world.

familiar.text: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

modern.text: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

original.text: ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ εἰσὶν καθὼς ἐγὼ ⸂οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου⸃.

verses.restored: Sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth.

familiar.text: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

modern.text: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.

original.text: ἁγίασον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ⸀ἀληθείᾳ· ὁ λόγος ὁ σὸς ἀλήθειά ἐστιν.

verses.restored: Just as you sent me into the world, I also sent them into the world.

familiar.text: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

modern.text: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.

original.text: καθὼς ἐμὲ ἀπέστειλας εἰς τὸν κόσμον, κἀγὼ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν κόσμον·

verses.restored: For them I sanctify myself, so that they also may be sanctified in truth.

familiar.text: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

modern.text: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth. Prayer for All Believers

original.text: καὶ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἁγιάζω ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ⸂ὦσιν καὶ αὐτοὶ⸃ ἡγιασμένοι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ.

verses.restored: I do not ask concerning these only, but also concerning those trusting into me through their word,

familiar.text: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

modern.text: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,

original.text: Οὐ περὶ τούτων δὲ ἐρωτῶ μόνον, ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ τῶν πιστευόντων διὰ τοῦ λόγου αὐτῶν εἰς ἐμέ,

verses.restored: so that all may be one, just as you, Father, are in me and I in you, that they also may be in us, so that the world may trust that you sent me.

familiar.text: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

modern.text: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.

original.text: ἵνα πάντες ἓν ὦσιν, καθὼς σύ, ⸀πάτερ, ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν σοί, ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ⸀ἡμῖν ὦσιν, ἵνα ὁ κόσμος ⸀πιστεύῃ ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.

verses.restored: The glory that you have given me I have given them, so that they may be one just as we are one,

familiar.text: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

modern.text: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—

original.text: κἀγὼ τὴν δόξαν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς ⸀ἕν,

verses.restored: I in them and you in me, so that they may be completed into one, so that the world may know that you sent me and loved them just as you loved me.

familiar.text: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

modern.text: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.

original.text: ἐγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ σὺ ἐν ἐμοί, ἵνα ὦσιν τετελειωμένοι εἰς ἕν, ⸀ἵνα γινώσκῃ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας καὶ ἠγάπησας αὐτοὺς καθὼς ἐμὲ ἠγάπησας.

verses.restored: Father, what you have given me, I will that where I am, those also may be with me, so that they may behold my glory that you have given me, because you loved me before the foundation of the world.

familiar.text: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

modern.text: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.

original.text: ⸀πάτερ, ⸀ὃ δέδωκάς μοι, θέλω ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ κἀκεῖνοι ὦσιν μετʼ ἐμοῦ, ἵνα θεωρῶσιν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἐμὴν ἣν ⸀δέδωκάς μοι, ὅτι ἠγάπησάς με πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου.

verses.restored: Righteous Father, the world did not know you, but I knew you, and these knew that you sent me.

familiar.text: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

modern.text: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.

original.text: ⸀Πάτερ δίκαιε, καὶ ὁ κόσμος σε οὐκ ἔγνω, ἐγὼ δέ σε ἔγνων, καὶ οὗτοι ἔγνωσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας,

verses.restored: I made your name known to them and will make it known, so that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.

familiar.text: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

modern.text: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”

original.text: καὶ ἐγνώρισα αὐτοῖς τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ γνωρίσω, ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ἣν ἠγάπησάς με ἐν αὐτοῖς ᾖ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς.
